definitions.explanation: The upper, arched surface of the foot, opposite the sole; the instep.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}の{甲|こう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: The top of my foot hurts.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}の{甲|こう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}けして→日焼けする：20314_hiyakesuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up sunburning the top of my foot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{足|あし}の{甲|こう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧、⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: The new shoes press on the top of my foot, and it hurts every time I walk.

notes:
⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot) + {甲|こう} (shell; upper/back surface). The arched top of the foot, contrasted with ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (the sole).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足|あし}の{甲|こう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have a high instep
- {足|あし}の{甲|こう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}める→痛める：13613_itameru⟧: to injure the top of the foot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手|て}の{甲|こう}→手の甲：06438_tenokou⟧: back of the hand — the same {甲|こう} used for the hand
